name: .224 Cal-52gr Hammer Hunter®

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "G1-BC= .220 from shot drops" (from shot drops).

note: Recommended use: Medium to Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This 52gr Hammer Hunter™ is designed for the 10″ twist rifles. The pure copper 70% weight retention bullet will handle small game up to hogs and deer."
